independent_adjudication.title: AI-orchestrated PaperCut campaign compromised at least 440 instances across 395 organizations
independent_adjudication.review_scope: Published v0.9.0 two-class delta only; all other class findings preserved, not re-adjudicated.

delta_decisions.basis: GreyNoise’s recovered campaign evidence identifies credential harvesting and extraction of full domain credential databases. Secret authentication content crossed victim custody boundaries. Administrator counts are not converted into an assumption that every one of the 395 organisations suffered the same extraction.

condition_tests.literal_condition: Identifiable material serves an authentication or authorisation function, or contains the protected secret content needed to exercise that function, in an AI-mediated system or dependent infrastructure.
condition_tests.assessment: The source episodes identify harvested credentials and extracted domain credential databases within the participating AI-mediated workflow or dependent infrastructure.

condition_tests.literal_condition: An independently evidenced custody boundary governs who or what may hold, receive, disclose, modify or replace the material in the assessed lifecycle stage.
condition_tests.assessment: The independently evidenced boundary is victim organisations’ authorised authentication-material holders.

condition_tests.literal_condition: Occurrence evidence demonstrates exposure outside that boundary, unauthorised acquisition, or unauthorised custody-changing modification or replacement. Demonstrated retrievability of protected secret content is sufficient without proof of subsequent credential use.
condition_tests.assessment: The realised operation is identified by the source-local decision: GreyNoise reports credential harvesting and extraction of domain credential databases after administrator access at twelve organisations. These are protected authentication objects, not mere successful logins.

condition_tests.literal_condition: Authentication material, its AI-mediated system or dependent infrastructure, and the applicable authorised custody boundary are identified.
condition_tests.assessment: This failure-occurrence decision does not assert successful-invariant for the same phase. The identified information and boundary are harvested credentials and extracted domain credential databases, governed by victim organisations’ authorised authentication-material holders.

condition_tests.literal_condition: A concrete handling operation, delegation, lifecycle transition or exposure attempt materially tests custody protection.
condition_tests.assessment: This failure-occurrence decision does not assert successful-invariant for the same phase. The concrete test is: GreyNoise reports credential harvesting and extraction of domain credential databases after administrator access at twelve organisations. These are protected authentication objects, not mere successful logins.

condition_tests.literal_condition: Observed handling or verification shows that the secret remains confined to authorised holders, recipients and pathways, with the applicable protection preserved through the tested operation.
condition_tests.assessment: The evidenced boundary crossing is not verified confinement.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The finding is limited to the tested material, operation and stage. Absence of reported misuse, ordinary credential availability, a missing key or an unverified rotation claim does not supply this evidence.
condition_tests.assessment: The evidenced boundary crossing is not verified confinement.

exclusion_tests.literal_exclusion: Class scope exclusion (all results): The material is only a non-secret identifier, public connection identifier, public verification key or public client configuration that is intended to be available in the assessed context. A separately exposed secret or unauthorised protected-information operation requires its own assessment.
exclusion_tests.assessment: The assessed objects are harvested credentials and extracted domain credential databases. Public connection identifiers, fake placeholders and public verification material are excluded; no such object supplies this custody finding.

exclusion_tests.literal_exclusion: Class scope exclusion (all results): The issue concerns only coherent propagation of expiry, revocation, refresh or replacement into sessions and dependent operations. Assess Authentication-State Continuity unless a separate custody property is evidenced.
exclusion_tests.assessment: Acquisition, exposure or custody-changing modification is assessed separately from propagation of expiry, revocation or session state.

exclusion_tests.literal_exclusion: Not aligned exclusion: Credential handling or delegation is validly authorised and preserves the applicable custody boundary. Mere credential possession or ordinary authorised use is not a custody defect.
exclusion_tests.assessment: Holder/recipient authority is tested against victim organisations’ authorised authentication-material holders, rather than inferred from technical possession or the agent’s objective.

exclusion_tests.literal_exclusion: Not aligned exclusion: Only a theoretical vulnerability, unverified secret classification, unusable placeholder or unsuccessful attempt is shown; protected authentication material is not demonstrated outside custody.
exclusion_tests.assessment: The accepted finding relies on the identified secret object and documented custody event. For Boundary, the real acquisition is established independently of potential downstream use.

exclusion_tests.literal_exclusion: Not aligned exclusion: Material is already invalid and no residual secret-protection or custody obligation is independently established. Do not assume every expired token remains a usable secret.
exclusion_tests.assessment: No expired or demonstrably unusable candidate supplies the finding. Working acquisition/use or the specifically unresolved secret identity bounds the decision.

exclusion_tests.literal_exclusion: Class scope exclusion (all results): The only property is the scope of an action performed using a credential, without a distinct custody issue. Assess the applicable authority or action class.
exclusion_tests.assessment: The decision addresses acquisition, exposure or custody-changing modification of authentication material; later action scope is not substituted for this event.

independent_adjudication.external_candidate_scope: Reviewed direct AC-3 and IA-5(g) against exact propositions. AC-6 assigned-task details, SC-28 selected information/properties and SC-8 transmission-specific conditions were not assumed. IA-5(a)/(h) initial-distribution/control obligations and IR 8587 signing-key scope are not established merely by exposure. ISO remains contextual only. Historical rows and seven-repair holds are preserved.

preservation_checks: Summary, factual basis, source records, all old mapping objects/relationships, HIM, context and all pre-existing external rows unchanged. Prior interpretive history appended only.
